intended_behavior: Add new parameter concurrent_invocation_mode with type ConcurrentInvocationMode (Literal["throw", "unsafe_reentrant"]), defaulting to "throw" to preserve current behavior. Store the parameter as self._concurrent_invocation_mode. Update the docstring to document this new parameter. Preserve existing initialization functionality.

Modify the locking logic to conditionally skip the lock acquire step if self._concurrent_invocation_mode == "unsafe_reentrant". If mode is "throw", behave as current: acquire lock non-blocking, raising ConcurrencyException if unavailable. If mode is "unsafe_reentrant", skip lock acquisition and allow concurrent invocations. Other aspects of method behavior remain unchanged.
Add type alias: ConcurrentInvocationMode = Literal["throw", "unsafe_reentrant"]. Allow this to be used for typing in Agent constructor and elsewhere.

Add test cases verifying: Concurrent invocation raises ConcurrencyException in "throw" mode. Concurrent invocations succeed without exceptions in "unsafe_reentrant" mode. Parallel tests added to existing concurrency tests if any present.
